visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character wearing a red and white varsity jacket, grey trousers, and a black beanie with goggles enters a brightly lit hotel-style bedroom. She approaches a twin bed where another person is completely covered under white bedding. She shakes the sleeper through the blanket and gestures urgently with her hands. (2) The female character walks toward a small refrigerator unit next to an air purifier and some suitcases. She opens the fridge door, scans the contents, and retrieves a silver and blue metallic can. (3) The camera focuses on the beverage can held by the female character against a plain white wall; the brand is identifiable as Kirin Hyoketsu. (4) The scene cuts back to the bed where the sleeping individual, a male, suddenly sits upright with a shocked facial expression and wide eyes, staring toward the can. (5) The female character stands holding the opened can while the male character remains upright in bed, looking surprised.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, loud female voice dominates the audio, shouting 'Eh!' and delivering rapid-fire speech about a restaurant reservation. The tone is insistent and high-arousal. There is no BGM, only the sound of rustling fabric. (2) A muffled male vocal groan responds briefly. The female voice repeats 'Quick! Wake up!' with even higher volume and intensity. (3) Footsteps are heard against a floor, followed by the mechanical click of a refrigerator door opening. (4) A sharp, distinct 'crack' and 'fizz' of a carbonated can being opened pierces the silence. (5) Immediately following the can pop, a male voice shouts at a very high volume: 'Who is drinking my alcohol?' in a shocked, high-arousal tone. (6) Upbeat, major-mode pop music with electronic synthesizers and a driving drum beat begins. A male singer performs lyrics in Mandarin about drinking today and yesterday with clear articulation.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit format to illustrate a relatable 'life hack' or joke where the sound of an alcoholic beverage being opened is more effective at waking a heavy sleeper than verbal shouting. It aims to entertain through exaggerated reactions and comedic timing.
